description: This file defines a class for transforming HTML FONT tags into SPAN tags with corresponding CSS styles. It converts deprecated font attributes like color, face, and size into CSS styles and handles the transformation process for both start and end tags within an HTML purification context.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_TagTransform_Font
classes.description: Class responsible for transforming FONT tags to SPAN tags with CSS styles in an HTML purification process.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms a FONT tag into a SPAN tag with appropriate CSS styling based on color, face, and size attributes.
